name: Summon Hawk
tooltip:
Summon Hawk
190 Mana35 yd range
6 sec cooldown
Requires Hunter
Requires level 60
Command a hawk to dive-bomb your targeted enemy, dealing [108 + (Ranged Attack Power * (0.05))] Physical damage and continuing its assault for 18 sec. Only 2 hawks can be active at once. Summon Hawk shares its cooldown with Arcane Shot.
